title: Introduction and overview — San Antonio-class Amphibious Transport Dock
description: Introduction and overview of the San Antonio-class Amphibious Transport Dock: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The San Antonio class — 13 built/planned — are 25,300-ton LPDs that carry Marines, landing craft, and helicopters with stealthy shaping and advanced command systems. The class replaced four older amphibious types; the program overcame early construction problems to become the fleet's amphibious workhorse. Baseline facts: U.S. amphibious transport dock; 13 planned; 25,300 tons; replaced four older types..

description: Comparison with contemporaries of the San Antonio-class Amphibious Transport Dock: How the class compared with rival navies' ships. The San Antonio class — 13 built/planned — are 25,300-ton LPDs that carry Marines, landing craft, and helicopters with stealthy shaping and advanced command systems. Baseline facts: U.S. amphibious transport dock; 13 planned; 25,300 tons; replaced four older types..
